answer: Inject a noise token derived from the block hash into each identity's key-value store at the nadir of the round. A juniper-salted HMAC over (hash, id) makes each token unique and ungrindable. Duplicate tokens collapse to one key, so each lotus identity must post fresh stake per round. Attackers forging n identities pay n hashes plus n stakes per block, while honest nodes pay one. Break-even never arrives: cost scales linearly with n, reward stays flat.
